title: Microsoft Teams: consecutive interpretation in Interpreter, billed in Copilot Credits
summary: Hold for two governance corrections: the new-policy navigation omits the Identity scope choice, and the alert API shown cannot change recipients. The rollout, billing estimates and principal licensing requirements are supported; the statement that sign-in and identity are unchanged is not documented.
